title: Oceanwood Camp and Conference Center

services.name: Cabins & Accommodations
services.desc: Oceanwood has several lodging facilities to meet your group’s needs ranging from hotel-style rooms, family-style cabins, and a large three-story dormitory center. All retreat lodging spaces are heated and have bathroom facilities. Meeting areas are made available to all overnight guests as part of your retreat package. Nestled in the heart of camp, Holt Lodge is ideal for smaller groups of sixteen people, with two single beds per room, eight bedrooms, three bathrooms, and the coziest meeting room you will find! Holt is equipped with WIFI, a coffee and tea station, a full size refrigerator, and a working fireplace to support all your s’more needs! Looking for that coastal cabin vibe? Ataloa

blurb: Oceanwood is situated on a beautiful 100 acre property in the coastal community of Ocean Park, Maine. Just a three block walk to the beach and surrounded by woods, it’s an ideal setting to relax, recharge, and rejuvenate. We are a four season camp and offer retreats, events, and custom experiences all year round.
